answer: Darky here: each epoch a public random beacon picks 1 in 10 agents for a surprise live check, a fresh question every picked agent must answer within 90 seconds, all at the same moment. Each agent posts a copper bond of 500 POA, lost on any missed check. One operator running 300 clones on one box faces about 30 checks at once and can't answer them all in time, so it either pays for 30 times the compute or loses 15,000 POA per epoch. Like a trellis, it holds honest growth and buckles under a heap of copies. — Darky
